name: TTM AI FAQ Schema for Elementor
author: themetechmount

sections.description:
AI FAQ Schema for Elementor helps website owners create FAQ sections with valid Google FAQPage JSON-LD schema, AI-powered content generation, and voice-search optimization.

Features:

  • Custom Elementor widget “AI FAQ Schema”
  • Unlimited FAQ items with reorder support
  • Accordion and toggle display styles
  • JSON-LD FAQ schema per widget instance
  • AI-powered FAQ generation using multiple supported AI providers
  • Voice search optimization mode
  • SEO scoring and rich snippet preview
  • Translation ready
  • GPL compliant

External Services

This plugin optionally connects to third-party AI services to generate FAQ content.

No data is transmitted unless the site administrator configures an API key and explicitly requests AI-generated FAQ content through the plugin.

When AI FAQ generation is used, the plugin sends the prompt, topic, keywords, and related content entered by the administrator to the selected AI provider for processing. The transmitted data depends on the content submitted by the administrator.

OpenAI

Used to generate FAQ content using OpenAI language models.

Data sent:

  • User-provided prompt
  • Topic, keywords, or content entered for FAQ generation

When data is sent:

  • Only when the administrator requests AI-generated FAQ content

Terms of Service:
https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/

Privacy Policy:
https://openai.com/privacy/

Google Gemini

Used to generate FAQ content using Google’s Gemini models.

Data sent:

  • User-provided prompt
  • Topic, keywords, or content entered for FAQ generation

When data is sent:

  • Only when the administrator requests AI-generated FAQ content

Terms of Service:
https://policies.google.com/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy

Groq

Used to generate FAQ content using AI models served through the Groq API.

Data sent:

  • User-provided prompt
  • Topic, keywords, or content entered for FAQ generation

When data is sent:

  • Only when the administrator requests AI-generated FAQ content

Terms of Service:
https://groq.com/terms-of-use/

Privacy Policy:
https://groq.com/privacy-policy/

OpenRouter

Used to generate FAQ content through supported AI models available via the OpenRouter platform.

Data sent:

  • User-provided prompt
  • Topic, keywords, or content entered for FAQ generation

When data is sent:

  • Only when the administrator requests AI-generated FAQ content

Terms of Service:
https://openrouter.ai/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://openrouter.ai/privacy

Hugging Face

Used to generate FAQ content through supported AI models available via the Hugging Face Inference API.

Data sent:

  • User-provided prompt
  • Topic, keywords, or content entered for FAQ generation

When data is sent:

  • Only when the administrator requests AI-generated FAQ content

Terms of Service:
https://huggingface.co/terms-of-service

Privacy Policy:

sections.installation:
1. Upload the ttm-ai-faq-schema-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Go to Settings > AI FAQ Schema and enter your preferred AI provider and API key.
  5. Edit a page with Elementor, search for AI FAQ Schema widget, and add your FAQs.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor 3.0 or higher is required.

Where do I add my OpenAI API key?

Go to Settings > AI FAQ Schema in the WordPress admin.
